character.usage: Create and export realistic humanoid base meshes for closed-source/commercial games without royalties. Replace runtime primitives with imported skinned meshes.

animation.license: Royalty-free use in video games with free Adobe ID
animation.usage: Rig humanoid fighter meshes and source boxing/combat locomotion clips. Do not redistribute raw Mixamo assets separately from the game.

environment.usage: Use PBR textures, HDRIs and 3D props for the urban yard. Prefer 1K-2K textures, baked lighting and LODs for iPhone 13.
